objective: Stop Cash Mode recording that Brain performed a commercial effect that nothing performed. `advanceWithinAuthority` in server/services/cash/operate.ts (around line 570-669) checks the standing commercial authority for CONTACT_BUYER and reads the SEND_A_MESSAGE capability; the moment that capability reads PRESENT it calls `beginExecution` with `firstAction: { action: 'CONTACT_BUYER', performedBy: 'BRAIN', detail: 'Reached <payer> through <channel> with the offer on this card.' }`, which writes a cash_actions row, a CASH_ACTION_RECORDED event saying the action 'was performed by brain', and moves the opportunity READY -> EXECUTING. No message is sent and no path goes through server/services/effects, so invariants 25 and 26 are broken: an effect is claimed without a receipt, and an unknown outcome is never recorded as unknown. It is latent only because every integration capability in server/services/cash/capabilities.ts has `read: null` and reads MISSING; the first integration that reads PRESENT would make Brain record contacts that never happened. A related defect in the same path: `beginExecution` (server/services/cash/opportunities.ts around 476-610) inserts the first action before the READY -> EXECUTING transition, so a call on an opportunity that is not READY leaves an action row behind for a transition that was refused.
expectedOutcome: Brain records a BRAIN-performed commercial action only from the outcome of an effect run through server/services/effects (`runExternalEffect` with a registered adapter for that capability): CONFIRMED records the action with the receipt reference and begins execution; UNCERTAIN records no performed action, begins nothing, and leaves a visible cash need saying the outcome is unknown and must not be retried automatically; FAILED records nothing and withholds with the reason. With no adapter registered for a capability, that capability cannot read PRESENT for this branch and the opportunity is withheld exactly as today. beginExecution records the first action only in the same transaction as a transition that succeeds.
nonGoals: Building any real messaging, invoicing or payment integration. No adapter that talks to the outside world is added; tests register a synthetic adapter.
Changing the standing commercial authority, COMMERCIAL_ACTIONS, the ceilings, or the evidence card.
Changing what a person records through POST /cash/opportunities/:id/execute, which stays PERSON-performed.
Rewriting or deleting any cash_actions or cash_events row already stored.

acceptanceConditions.statement: A test makes SEND_A_MESSAGE read PRESENT without registering an effect adapter and asserts advanceWithinAuthority records no cash_actions row with performed_by BRAIN, leaves the opportunity READY, and reports it withheld with a reason naming the missing effect path.

With a synthetic adapter registered that returns CONFIRMED, the action row carries the receipt reference and the opportunity moves to EXECUTING; run twice, exactly one action row and one effect operation exist.

With a synthetic adapter that returns UNCERTAIN (and one that throws a timeout), no performed action is recorded, the opportunity stays READY, an open cash need names the unknown outcome, and a second pass does not send again.
beginExecution called with a firstAction on an opportunity that is not READY writes no cash_actions row.
The existing suites tests/cashProposal.test.ts, tests/cashIntegrationPass.test.ts and tests/cashOperate.test.ts still pass, and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Discard the branch. The change adds no schema and rewrites no stored row; the path it changes is unreachable in production because every integration capability reads MISSING.
